author: PluralTuna
body:
It is my best raider. Agony40+ (shackled) with the right gear, I am zeroing every raid's attack. Build it like Towerfall (starting at 1HP for redline), but with Fey Gerd armor (though chest can be Aaru Robe/Beastfelled Cuirass for the Mag/Att buff, depending on which is higher), and use Def/Res buffs first. 

It *does* get significantly better at higher Ang/AL (and your gear has to match your Ang level), so you might be better off with ASG if those are low.

I timed a Fey Jorm earlier today at 25 seconds

author: machumpo
body: I use it as beowulf hydrus where it buffs me, but for beowulf auriga you can make a towerfall-style build where you focus on increasing your dark damage since its only attack skill of Yggdrasil's Fury II deals holy and dark damage.  Since it applies a dark sigil, it is probably better to max out your dark damage.  For max damage, dual wield two Finesse's Enchanted Epee and fill them with soul of achyls.  Use amities that increase your dark damage.  For the rest of your gear you might focus on crit and ward.  Then in the raid, buff up and do what you need to survive while the seedhusk does all the damage.

author: Desperate-Grand4905
body: Like someone else said, when used in a towerfall style build it can do some pretty strong dmg, on the flip side, ive seen it shine in pvp hugely, the amount of beo’s ive run into using it in pvp is insane, not sure if beoH or beoA but i know it works pretty well for them so maybe give it a try there as well?

author: Yggy_
body:
I keen on separating followers on 4 categories 

Aggressive ones: followers like ASG, Cactus 

Defensive ones: Like Mammoth, ArchLivingArmor

Support ones: like Phoenix, penguin 

And Guild assistants: like the rabbits or the Wisps.

Well Seed looks like a support one, dark align buffer with a carefully placed DC on Bond2.
With carefully placed I mean the follower will shine on a Hydrus rather than Auriga or base.

body: Unrelated to your question but the seed is also very good for climbing towers

author: dfoley323
body:
ASG is weak (penetration) and resistable (can immune his attacks).

Seed husk does balls to the wall damage and cant be immune....there is no comparison, seed husk is hands down our 2nd best pet for raid damage, but our 1st pet for raid speed (it only has 1 attack so it doesnt waste time)
